about_the_game:
Welcome to "From Madness with Love", a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with!

Spend a year of school life with four guys and make choices to build up your relationship with the guy you like! As you interact with them more and more, you will face challenges, and you'll uncover their secrets...! Will you be able to have a happy ending with the guy you love?

Summary

You are the main character, a simple high school sophomore. However, last year your high school was bombed by terrorists, so you were transferred to the closest school to your home—a private school for rich kids.

The love-filled Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC is here!

- What if your best boys swapped bodies...?

- What if your crush were a *******...? And you were sucking each other's... I mean, huh?!

- What if you didn't do a certain thing at a certain time...?

The world of From Madness with Love is more chaotic and more incomprehensible than ever!

Overcome any and all hardships with your love and embark on a new path with your favorite boy!!! This DLC contains additional content for those who don't want the school life filled with love and madness to end!

※This DLC contains 2 brand new episodes and 1 brand new ending,

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains elements of violence, horror, and otherwise sensitive topics.
